e2e.auth_notes: Single actor: the seeded admin, whose credentials come from the sample .env only (openclinica has no in-flow signup). Pristine state is the fresh Liquibase seed after environments/openclinica/scripts/reset-pristine.sh — the sample's 'never drop the DB' contract applies to agent e2e tests, not to harness capture runs.

db.notes: expected_delta.json is captured from the pristine app (never hand-written). subject/study_subject are the behavior under test; audit_log_event records the creation audit trail (audit_date ignored); user_account changes on login (date_lastvisit ignored). audit_user_login is deliberately excluded: auth plumbing with a volatile login_attempt_date, same rationale as mamute's UserSession. enrollment_date is ignored because the form prefills it with today; the flow fills a fixed date but the column format is locale-sensitive. Pristine state = fresh Liquibase seed after environments/openclinica/scripts/reset-pristine.sh.
